enum.statLocationBasis.案件發生地點（鄉鎮市區精度；來源未: Place of occurrence (township/district precision; the source does not say whether this is where the victim was defrauded or where the case was reported)
enum.statLocationBasis.清潔隊清運責任區（區隊與行政區一對: Sanitation team collection zone (one team per district); not necessarily where residents generate the waste
enum.statLocationBasis.門牌所在行政區（月底累計）: District of the street address (cumulative at month end)
enum.statLocationBasis.工廠登記地址所在行政區（月底家數）: District of the factory's registered address (count at month end)
enum.statLocationBasis.建築地點所在行政區（依發照日期）: District of the building site (by permit issue date)
enum.statLocationBasis.死亡者戶籍所在地（依死亡年）: Deceased's registered residence (by year of death)
enum.statLocationBasis.登記或聯絡地址所在行政區（非表演地: District of the registered or contact address (not where they perform)
enum.statLocationBasis.國有非公用土地所在縣市: County where the state land lies
enum.statLocationBasis.國有非公用房地所在縣市: County where the state real estate lies
enum.statLocationBasis.ATM 裝設縣市: County where the ATM is installed
enum.statLocationBasis.金融機構（總機構／分支）所在縣市: County of the institution (head office / branch)
enum.statLocationBasis.ATM 裝設點／分支機構所在鄉鎮市: Township of the ATM site / branch
enum.statLocationBasis.金融及保險業場所單位所在縣市: County of the finance & insurance establishment
enum.statLocationBasis.交易發生地（交易系統記錄之縣市；跨: Where the transaction occurred (county recorded by the system; interbank remittances likely by receiving institution)
enum.statLocationBasis.壽險公司分公司、通訊處所在縣市: County of the life insurer branch or sales office
enum.statLocationBasis.特約商店登記地址所在鄉鎮市區: Township of the merchant's registered address
enum.statLocationBasis.常住地所在地方行政區（LAD 20: Local authority district of usual residence (2024 LAD boundaries)
enum.statLocationBasis.居住地所在地方行政區（由普查小區分: Local authority district of residence (aggregated from census output-area classes)
enum.statLocationBasis.小區所在地方行政區（由小區排名彙整: Local authority district containing each small area (aggregated from small-area ranks)
enum.statLocationBasis.房屋所在地方行政區（LAD 202: Local authority district where the property is (2026 LAD boundaries)
enum.statLocationBasis.租賃住宅所在地方行政區（LAD 2: Local authority district where the rented home is (2026 LAD boundaries)
enum.statLocationBasis.農戶所在地方行政區（依農戶歸戶，不: Local authority district of the holding (allocated by holding, not where the land actually lies; 2026 LAD boundaries)
enum.statLocationBasis.統計對象所在行政區（2024 年統: Area where the counted unit is (2024 Statistics Korea boundaries mapped to October 2026 boundaries)
enum.statLocationBasis.在地人數所在的首爾自治區（電信推估: Seoul autonomous district where people are present (telecom estimate)
enum.statLocationBasis.常住地所在的省／普查區（2021: Province / census division of usual residence (2021 Census boundaries)
enum.statLocationBasis.家戶常住地所在的省／普查區（202: Province / census division where the household usually resides (2021 Census boundaries)
enum.statLocationBasis.投開票所所在村里（依中選會投開票所: Village where the polling station is located (CEC polling stations matched to current village boundaries); townships and counties sum all polling stations
enum.statLocationBasis.火災發生地所在行政區（2026-1: Area where the fire occurred (October 2026 boundaries)
enum.statLocationBasis.事故發生地所在行政區（2026-1: Area where the accident occurred (October 2026 boundaries)
enum.statLocationBasis.常住地所在的地方政府／選舉分區（2: Local authority / electoral division of usual residence (2022 Census)
enum.statLocationBasis.家戶常住地所在的地方政府／選舉分區: Local authority / electoral division where the household usually resides (2022 Census)
enum.statLocationBasis.出租住宅所在的郡（RTB 地點，對: County where the rented dwelling is located (RTB location, matched to local authorities)
enum.statLocationBasis.發布機關所屬縣市（縣市政府、所屬機: County of the publishing agency (county government, its agencies, township offices); not the area the data covers
enum.statLocationBasis.就讀學校所在鄉鎮市區（不是學生住家: Township of the school attended (not the student's home)
enum.statLocationBasis.坑洞所在縣市（來源表所列縣市；台中: County or city where the pit is (as listed in the source; Taichung, Tainan and Kaohsiung combine the former county and city)
enum.statLocationBasis.病例居住地所在鄉鎮市區（境外移入病: Township of the case's residence (imported cases are also by residence)
enum.statLocationBasis.病例居住地所在縣市（境外移入病例也: County or city of the case's residence (imported cases are also by residence)
enum.statLocationBasis.普查常住地所在鄉鎮市區（常住人口，: Township of usual residence in the census (resident population, excluding migrant workers)
enum.statLocationBasis.戶籍登記地所在鄉鎮市區（戶籍原住民: Township of household registration (registered indigenous population)
enum.statLocationBasis.電表所在郵遞區對到的鄉鎮市區（縣市: Township of the meter's postal zone (county for the county level)
enum.statLocationBasis.公司登記所在縣市（總公司）: County where the company is registered (head office)
enum.statLocationBasis.場所單位所在鄉鎮市區: Township where the establishment is located
enum.statLocationBasis.戶籍登記地（遷入縣市／遷出縣市依戶: County or city of household registration (destination and origin by registration)
enum.statLocationBasis.查獲（受理）警察機關所在縣市，不是: County of the police agency that seized (accepted) the case; not the place of residence or occurrence
enum.statLocationBasis.個案居住縣市（本國籍）: County of residence of the case (Taiwanese nationals)
enum.statLocationBasis.個案居住鄉鎮市區（本國籍、依診斷日: Township/district of residence of the case (Taiwanese nationals, by diagnosis date, confirmed cases)
enum.statLocationBasis.地方檢察署受理（轄區不等於縣市；只: Accepted by district prosecutors offices (jurisdiction is not the same as a county; only the 14 offices whose jurisdiction is exactly one county are shown)
enum.statLocationBasis.地方檢察署受理，以 22 個地檢署: Accepted by district prosecutors offices, shown by the 22 office jurisdictions (jurisdiction is not the same as a county; where the case was accepted, not where people live or the event occurred)
enum.statLocationBasis.服務據點所在行政區（名冊快照）: District of the service site (register snapshot)
enum.statLocationBasis.受訪者現住縣市（抽樣調查）: County where respondents currently live (sample survey)
enum.statLocationBasis.112年綜所稅申報戶所得；界線為同: Household income on 2023 individual income tax returns; boundaries are the native boundaries shipped with the same SEGIS 2023 village statistics file (unassigned areas excluded); villages with missing source values are not filled with zero.
enum.statLocationBasis.本國籍全時受僱員工的實際工作所在地: Actual workplace location of full-time employed Taiwanese nationals; not the place of residence, household registration, tax filing or insurance enrollment. Kinmen and Lienchiang are not covered.
enum.statLocationBasis.人力資源調查的居住地統計；來源無: Labor force survey statistics by place of residence; the source has no native geometry, so the Ministry of the Interior county boundary (2025-03-18 version) is used as a reference boundary; Kinmen and Lienchiang are not covered.
enum.statLocationBasis.人力資源調查居住地統計；manuf: Labor force survey statistics by place of residence; manufacturing is a subset of industry, and the four industry dimensions can only be selected exactly; Kinmen and Lienchiang are not covered.
enum.statLocationBasis.戶籍登記地（村里）；非常住地、非工: Household registration location (village); not the place of usual residence or work.
enum.statLocationBasis.戶籍登記所在村里（按登記日期）；非: Village of household registration (by registration date); not where the event occurred or where people usually live.
enum.statLocationBasis.戶籍登記地（遷入／遷出依登記）；非: Household registration location (moves in/out as registered); not the place of usual residence or actual residential moves.
enum.statLocationBasis.歸化者的戶籍縣市（來源按縣市彙總）: County of household registration of naturalized persons (source aggregates by county); not the place of usual residence.
enum.statLocationBasis.來源表所列縣市；不等於災害發生地（: County listed in the source table; not the same as where the disaster occurred (landslides and damage are tallied by the responsible agency's county)
enum.statLocationBasis.school_location_t: Township/district where the school is located
enum.statLocationBasis.擱淺發現地縣市: County where the stranding was found
enum.statLocationBasis.清理所在縣市（地方政府填報）: County where the cleanup took place (reported by local governments)
enum.statLocationBasis.來源表所列縣市歸屬（環保／主管機關: County assignment listed in the source table (environmental or competent-authority statistics); the source does not say what the location means more precisely, so do not read it as where an event occurred or where a facility or discharge is located
enum.statLocationBasis.來源表所列縣市；來源未說明為登記地: County listed in the source table; the source does not say whether it is the registered or business location, unverified, so it must not be used as facility coordinates
enum.statLocationBasis.來源表所列抽驗縣市；未驗證是否等於: County of sampling listed in the source table; not verified whether it equals the county of water supply or water source
enum.statLocationBasis.內政部國土管理署公布之縣市別；單一: County breakdown published by the Construction and Planning Agency, Ministry of the Interior; single release
enum.statLocationBasis.車籍縣市（非檢測站所在地）；應到檢: County of vehicle registration (not the location of the inspection station); the number due for inspection does not exclude unused motorcycles
enum.statLocationBasis.縣市政府體育運動經費；人口口徑為運: Sports funding of county and city governments; population basis is the total population given in the Ministry of Sports file
enum.statLocationBasis.受訪者居住縣市（抽樣調查推估）: County where respondents live (sample survey estimate)
enum.statLocationBasis.縣市政府（地方政府財政主體）: County or city government (local government fiscal entity)
enum.statLocationBasis.申報戶籍所在縣市（綜所稅申報地），: County of registered household at filing (where the income tax return is filed); not the workplace
enum.statLocationBasis.營業人稅籍登記縣市（非實際營業／消: County of the business's tax registration (not where it actually operates or where consumption occurs)
enum.statLocationBasis.依指標：居民指標＝持卡人居住縣市；: By indicator: resident indicators = county where cardholders live; consumption-place indicators = county where the transaction took place
enum.statLocationBasis.開立發票營業人所在縣市: County of the business that issued the invoice
enum.statLocationBasis.場所單位（工廠、店面、營業處所）所: County of the establishment (factory, storefront or business premises)
enum.statLocationBasis.金融機構分支單位所在縣市（非存戶居: County of the financial institution branch (not where depositors live)
enum.statLocationBasis.疾管署縣市別統計；來源未說明縣市歸: Statistics by county from the Taiwan CDC; the source does not say whether the county is the place of residence or of reporting
enum.statLocationBasis.個案居住地鄉鎮市區（鄉鎮名已由來源: Township/district of residence of the case (township names mapped back by the source to current administrative districts)
enum.statLocationBasis.個案居住縣市（依診斷年）；全國另含: County of residence of the case (by year of diagnosis); the national total also includes cases with unknown residence
enum.statLocationBasis.個案戶籍縣市: County of household registration of the case
enum.statLocationBasis.產婦現住地縣市（出生通報；與戶政出: County where the mother currently lives (birth notification; differs from household-registration birth records)
enum.statLocationBasis.各縣市衛生所及合約院所接種統計；應: Vaccination statistics from each county's health centers and contracted clinics; the cohorts due and cutoff dates follow the Taiwan CDC definitions
enum.statLocationBasis.衛福部統計處縣市別統計；分母依統計: County statistics from the Ministry of Health and Welfare's Department of Statistics; denominators follow that department's definitions
enum.statLocationBasis.保留地所在縣市（地政事務所註記），: County where the reserved land lies (as annotated by the land office); not the right holder's household registration
enum.statLocationBasis.被發布警戒的土石流潛勢溪流所在縣市: County of the debris-flow potential streams for which alerts were issued
enum.statLocationBasis.縣市（跨 22 縣市標準化的相對位: County (relative position standardized across the 22 counties and cities)
enum.statLocationBasis.申報／戶籍村里：112年綜所稅申報: Filing / household registration village: Household income on 2023 individual income tax returns; boundaries are the native boundaries shipped with the same SEGIS 2023 village statistics file (unassigned areas excluded); villages with missing source values are not filled with zero.
enum.statLocationBasis.實際工作場所縣市：本國籍全時受僱員: Actual workplace county: Actual workplace location of full-time employed Taiwanese nationals; not the place of residence, household registration, tax filing or insurance enrollment. Kinmen and Lienchiang are not covered.
enum.statLocationBasis.居住地：人力資源調查的居住地統計；: Place of residence: Labor force survey statistics by place of residence; the source has no native geometry, so the Ministry of the Interior county boundary (2025-03-18 version) is used as a reference boundary; Kinmen and Lienchiang are not covered.
enum.statLocationBasis.居住地：人力資源調查居住地統計；m: Place of residence: Labor force survey statistics by place of residence; manufacturing is a subset of industry, and the four industry dimensions can only be selected exactly; Kinmen and Lienchiang are not covered.
